acceptance: The app uses exact qualified framework versions and builds as a self-hostable Next.js standalone application.
A user can view projects, create an ephemeral project, open a project, and return to the project list without fake persistence claims.
The workspace renders primary navigation/context, work surface, typed activity/event panel, placeholder preview, and command/change-intent entry.
Activity fixtures validate against the public EventRecord contract rather than ad hoc event shapes.
The shell explicitly labels preview/generation/persistence capabilities that are not yet implemented instead of simulating success.
Keyboard/accessibility-oriented component tests and responsive structural tests pass.
Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI passes.

required: Focused shell interaction and EventRecord integration tests.
Production Next.js build using qualified exact framework versions.
Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI.

minimality.rationale: Create only the first earned real control-plane application and reuse the qualified framework/protocol contracts; do not introduce a component library or persistence stack yet.

requirements: Do not imply project persistence, AI generation, preview execution, or provider connectivity before those capabilities exist.
Do not introduce secrets, provider credentials, or production side effects.

outcome: Ineractive has a real Next.js control-plane shell with ephemeral project list/create/open flow, primary workspace layout, typed activity panel, placeholder preview, and command/change-intent entry without claiming persistence or generation.
rationale: Canonical P01-S03-T01 frontier after SG-000011 protocol records.

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000012 app/workspace/package/lockfile/docs changes; no external provider resource or persisted user data is created.

scope_in: Create the real control-plane app using qualified Next.js App Router 16.3.5 with React/React DOM 19.3.0 and Node 24.
Implement an ephemeral project list plus create/open interaction sufficient to exercise the shell before P01-S05 persistence.

Implement the primary workspace layout with navigation context, central work surface, activity/event panel consuming public EventRecord-shaped fixtures, placeholder preview surface, and command/change-intent entry.
Provide accessible semantic structure, keyboard-reachable controls, responsive shell behavior, and explicit empty/loading/error-like shell states where applicable.
Add focused component/contract tests plus production build evidence without provider deployment.
scope_out: No Supabase/auth/database persistence; P01-S05 owns persisted control-plane identity/project state.
No full tokenized design system or final Ineractive visual identity; P01-S04 owns that work.
No AI generation execution, model routing, capability kernel, preview runtime, code editor, or backend compiler.
No Vercel-only API or provider deployment.
